Argonite ore can be found in the Sinkholes Distraction and Diversion.
Attuned portent of restoration VII is a portent created with level 67 Divination and level 62 Constitution using 45 vibrant energy and 1 monkfish or using 6 memory shards, yielding 13.
The augmented chaotic maul is a level 80 Melee two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a chaotic maul.
Bandit Camp Teleport scrolls are obtained from all levels of treasure trails clues.

sc: The bathus hatchet is a tier 2 hatchet, found in Daemonheim.
It can be made from one bathus bar, requiring level 12 Smithing and giving 20 experience.
Beach Strawberry Hair is a head slot cosmetic override unlocked by redeeming a strawberry hair head token.
Big bones are an item dropped by larger monsters inside Daemonheim.
A green bird's egg is an item that can be found in bird's nests, which fall from trees while Woodcutting.
Biscuit dough is made by combining a pot of flour and a pat of butter.
It is created by combining 100 Scraps of scripture, requiring 92 Crafting.

The Boots of Flight are obtained when excavating any Ikovian memorial (requiring level 70 Archaeology) near the Stormguard portal while inside the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site during the Leap of Faith mystery.
Once obtained, it can be added to the player's tool belt.
It can be obtained by using a bottle with the red mist that appears after an armoured zombie within the Chaos Temple Dungeon is killed.
A brass hand is a quest item obtained from the Rocking Out quest.
It is made using the Smithing skill by putting together the five pieces from a broken hand, with a hammer and 2 bronze wires in the inventory.
To obtain a bronze halberd, players can either buy one at the Quartermaster's store in Tyras Camp or buy one from another player, or it can be obtained from the mystery cracker.
Like all other halberds, the bronze halberd cannot be made with the Smithing skill.
The bronze key was made by giving a key print and a bronze bar to Osman, and it could be collected from Leela during Prince Ali Rescue to open the cell door to Prince Ali.
The outfit piece can be created by combining 3,600 shark fragments at an inventor's workbench, where the player will randomly receive 1 piece of all the shark outfits until all are owned.
They were previously possible to obtain from Treasure Hunter from 26 March 2015 00:00 UTC to 30 March 2015 23:59 UTC.
Chinchompa plushie is an item that can be purchased as part of the Amare (purple) outfit for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be received as part of a Twitch Prime offer from 5 February to 19 March 2019, which requires linking the player's RuneScape account to .

Circus (Crowd) Hat.x: The Circus (Crowd) Hat is a head slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza as part of the Circus (Crowd) outfit. It is unlocked alongside its item version.

Clue scroll (hard) - 12 degrees 48 minut.x: Clue scroll (hard) is a coordinate clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: Clue scroll (medium) is a simple clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
A contract is an item that can be obtained to keep track of the player's current contract from either Sojobo (contracts), Hubbub (contracts), or Ling (contracts) in the Arc.
A maximum of three contracts can be completed per day unless an increase has been purchased from Waiko Reward Shop, which increases the maximum to 7 contracts.
The below contracts may be obtained from Hubbub (contracts).

sc: The crumbling tome, or Legend of the Brothers, is found on a desk in a building just east of the entrance to the Barrows.
Culinaromancer's gloves 7, also called adamant gloves, are special metal gloves that can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest after completion of any 6 Recipe for Disaster subquests.
Dioscuri Halberd is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 30 of Zodiyak Track.
It can be bought for 99,000 coins (or 92,000 coins with the ring of charos (a) or its imbued version) alongside the Divination hood from Orla Fairweather, who can be found near the Draynor jail.
Of these, Option 6 won by a significant margin, with 41% of the votes.

Divination flask.x: The is a potion flask containing six doses of potion. It is created by using potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

sc: A dreamy lamp is a quest item rewarded for completing the Dream Mentor quest.

v: Only during Perils of Ice Mountain and if the player doesn't already have the item.
sc: This key can be found on Drorkar, the owner of the dragon coal burners, and must be obtained via pickpocketing him within the power-plant.
Equipping the hauberk will immediately cause it to begin degrading—even outside of combat—and it must be repaired before it can be traded again.
The emerald amulet is made by using a gold bar, a cut emerald and an amulet mould on a furnace.

The Equilibrium Relic Hunter (Tier 3) token is an item purchasable from the Leagues Reward Shop for 3,500 league points that can be redeemed to unlock the Equilibrium Relic Hunter (Tier 3) outfit override, destroying the token in the process.
The eternal magic staff (ascended) is a piece of ascended equipment that can be created with level 104 Runecrafting by ascending an eternal magic staff (saturated) at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar.
Once the ascending has been completed, the item is immediately removed from your backpack; players can't obtain the ascended staff as an item.
The limit extender can be purchased from the event interface for 60 RuneCoins.
Fancy Hat is a head slot cosmetic override obtained as a reward after activating buffs on eight separate days during the Birthday Buff Bonanza event.

Furies Agent Gauntlets is the hands-slot override component of the Furies Agent outfit, awarded after handing in a total of 3,000 or more Zamorakian emblems to Miithrius and Zymthara throughout the duration of the Agents of Fury event.
A garish-pink partyhat was a joke item partyhat dropped by JMod clones during the Battle of Lumbridge.
The ghostly farmer boots are part of the ghostly farmer outfit which is made with 600 ghostweave.
The gilded cabbage is an extra item obtained after The Death of Chivalry quest.
After the quest is completed, it can be looted from one of the coffins in the room where players fight Dawn, the final boss of the quest.
It can be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track.

Glad Tidings Headpiece.x: The Glad Tidings Headpiece is a male-only head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Glad Tidings set.

sc: Golden Linza's greaves is tier 80 melee tank legs armour that is obtained by winning a raffle in the Balthazar's Big Raffle during September 2019.
For players wishing to fill their cape rack, it's possible to obtain all 3 types of capes from the statues by just praying to each of them.
Guthix cape.x: The Guthix cape is a reward from the Mage Arena minigame. To receive the cape, the player must win the activity by defeating Kolodion in his four guises, then speak to him, step through the nearby sparkling pool, and finally pray at the statue of Guthix. If lost, players can get a new cape by once again praying at the statue of Guthix.

The crossbow can be bought from Leon for 1,300 coins, who is located in the Hunter shop in Yanille.
The Inverted Hunter master skillcape token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach virtual level 120 Hunter during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).

Katagon boots is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.

The medium fortune star (Magic) is a reward for completing a cloud of destiny in the Magic skill, as part of the Spring Fayre event.
Necromancy XP lamp is a reward item given upon completion of Rune Mythos quest.

sc: Ogre arrows require level 5 Fletching to make, and are made using achey tree logs.
A chisel is then used on a set of wolf bones to produce 4 wolf bone arrowheads, which are then attached to the flighted arrows to obtain ogre arrows.

They may be pickpocketed from farmers and seed stalls or bought from Olivia in Draynor market or Head Farmer Jones in Taverley.
Onion seeds may also be obtained when harvesting onions from a field.

Ornate Orb.x: Ornate Orb is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Ornate Magic Weapon Pack.

Polarising crystal.x: Given to you by Death during the 2020 Halloween event. It can be interacted with to give you a hint on where to find the location of the soul fragments.

Pots of cream can be purchased from the Culinaromancer's chest in Lumbridge Castle's cellar after a point in the Recipe for Disaster quest, and also from Hudo or Heckel Funch at the Tree Gnome Stronghold for 19 coins each.

Raw arcane apoterrasaur meat is an item obtained by hunting an arcane apoterrasaur.
Raw bird meat is a drop from Hunter birds.
Players may receive raw bird meat from opening a box of summoning ingredients, a possible reward from the Familiarisation Distractions and Diversions.
Raw catfish is a type of fish that can be caught with level 60 Fishing in the Menaphos fishing spots, using a fishing rod and fishing bait.

tx:
• Using these potions to gain extra healing or damage-dealing special attacks can be extremely useful against boss monsters. Doing so effectively reduces the restore time of the special bar from 5 minutes to 1½ minutes.
• These potions can be used to recover special attack for an Enhanced Excalibur special, thus healing you. This use effectively turns your Recover Special into a food item.
• The same scenario goes with the Saradomin godsword; the recover special is effective as both a prayer recovery and a healing item.
• The Invigorate aura and its superior versions do not boost the amount of energy restored.

Both ingredients are consumable if left-clicked. As such, making these potions without waste requires a bit more attention than most other potions. It's suggested to use the one-button mouse option, effectively forcing a right click so that neither of the ingredients will be accidentally consumed.
sc: Recover special potions are made by players using the Herblore skill.
The potion cannot be made with the assistance of others.
The Relic is an item obtained in The Temple at Senntisten.
A yellow robe top can be purchased from Barker at his store Barker's Haberdashery in Canifis.
When taken to the dragon forge, found in the Ancient Cavern, a player can unite the three ruined dragon armour pieces into a dragon platebody with the use of a blast fusion hammer.
Shadow Gorilla is a legendary pet that was available from Solomon's General Store for 1,500 RuneCoins (1,350 for members) until 28 February 2017.

Silken top (blue).x: The blue silken top is part of the silken outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Skirt (maroon) is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.
There are three types of skirts which may be awarded to players.
A small XP lamp (Crafting) is a common prize from Treasure Hunter.
Snowballs can now be made from glacor remnants which are obtained from glacytes and Arch-Glacor.
Snowballs are available through fletching them from the pile of snow in Christmas Village.
Sorcerer's boots, which require 54 Defence to wear, are a rare drop from cave slimes in Daemonheim.
Spiritbloom gloves are an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
They may be obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
Stalker notes (part 5) is a drop from World-gorger Shukarhazh in Daemonheim.
The stone left leg is a quest item found in the Enakhra's Lament quest.
It is obtained by searching a statue made by the player after it has dropped through the roof of the underground temple in the desert near the Bandit Camp.
Strength XP lamp is a possible reward from the Observatory Quest.
The strong fishing urn (empty) is created by using a water rune on a strong fishing urn (no rune).
It is made by adding clean buckthorn and misshapen claw to a vial of water.
The strong runecrafting urn (empty) is created by using a pure essence on a strong runecrafting urn (no rune).
The telescope is an item that could be purchased from the Marketplace for 700 oddments before the rotating cosmetic stock update on 4 March 2024.
Previously it has also been available from the rare token store and from the Oddments Store for 700 oddments.
A thin snail is a piece of raw meat that is primarily dropped by monsters in Mort Myre Swamp.
Players may receive thin snails from opening a box of summoning ingredients, a possible reward from the Familiarisation Distraction and Diversion.

Toolkit (Castle Wars).x: The toolkit is an item used in Castle Wars to repair catapults and the double doors, which are located on the floor 2 of the castle.

sc: It can be made by crafting a branch cut from the swaying tree east of Rellekka.
The part is awarded for completing 1,500 bosses killed, with at least 30 kills on each boss.
The warlord headdress is a headwear won from Treasure Hunter.
This item can be obtained by both members and free players.
Whiteberry seeds may be bought from Vinesweeper for 25 points each.
The Winter Hat is a head slot item created by combining all six Winter Hats received during the 2023 Christmas event.
